exact_results.scope: There is an order k1 such that the vertically reduced jet bundles have locally constant rank at every order k>=k1. The finite-jet version is over J_(k+1), not one common finite-level base.
For every fixed infinite jet X, there is an order l(X) beyond which the symbol contractions/prolongation inclusion hold, under the stated regularity hypothesis.
The eventual equality with algebraic prolongation likewise has an order k1(X) depending on X.
The localized regularity hypotheses and conclusion allow an open neighborhood of X_(k+1) that depends on k.

quantifier_comparison.cited_pointwise: For every X there exists l(X) such that for every k>=l(X), P(X,k).
quantifier_comparison.cited_local: For a fixed X and each sufficiently large k there is a neighborhood W_(k+1) of X_(k+1) on which the stated order-k property holds.
quantifier_comparison.required_uniform: There exist a finite l and a nonempty invariant Zariski open U in E^l such that P(a,k) holds for every k>=l and every compatible higher jet a above U.

finite_level_orbit_quotient.hypotheses: Smooth affine algebraic group with regular action on an integral separated complex variety; real descent requires a geometrically integral variety and geometrically reduced affine algebraic group.
finite_level_orbit_quotient.construction: Reduced monic basis of the full restricted orbit graph; coefficient functions separate orbit closures and normal-form coefficient ratios generate the invariant field.
finite_level_orbit_quotient.domain: Nonempty invariant open in this fixed variety; target is an integral finite-type variety.
finite_level_orbit_quotient.fibres: Single full-group orbits on all algebraically closed extension fields.
finite_level_orbit_quotient.scope: This is the pointwise orbit quotient and field identification defined in Theorem 4.19; no additional scheme-theoretic quotient universal property is asserted.

source.title: Rational invariants of a group action. Construction and rewriting

horizontal_rank_and_quotient_derivations.hypotheses: Integral algebraic jet tower with dominant projections, regular finite-level actions and covariant regular total differentiation; smooth-base version uses transitivity and integral jet fibres.
horizontal_rank_and_quotient_derivations.domain: Full regularity and independence locus of finitely many invariant horizontal differentials, at one finite level.
horizontal_rank_and_quotient_derivations.uniformity: All larger minors are zero rational identities; they vanish at every higher field-valued jet where their entries are regular.
horizontal_rank_and_quotient_derivations.quotient: The horizontal space modulo the common annihilator is canonically dual to the span of invariant horizontal differentials.
horizontal_rank_and_quotient_derivations.derivatives: Coefficient derivations dual to the selected differentials, represented by inverse-matrix coefficients at the finite level; invariant under the full action as operations on invariants.
horizontal_rank_and_quotient_derivations.representative_independence: Differences annihilate the selected forms and hence every invariant; annihilating fields form a Lie ideal among preserving fields.
horizontal_rank_and_quotient_derivations.commutation: The selected quotient derivations commute on the invariant field, even if their horizontal representatives have a nonzero annihilating bracket.
horizontal_rank_and_quotient_derivations.function_class: Rational through the chosen finite level and polynomial in higher graph jets; filtration shift at most +1 above that level.

finite_observations.hypotheses: Integral Q-algebra, commuting tangential derivations with graph jet shift, arbitrary equation-coefficient normal derivations, finite determining and polynomial observation rows.
finite_observations.conclusion: One coefficient localization, one finite raw word/order bound and a split observed relation space valid for every ordinary field specialization and every higher truncation.
finite_observations.normal_curvature: Whole unipotently gauged observation copies retain curvature. No normally prolonged free scalar observation is substituted.
finite_observations.finite_order: Dummy components receive the maximum observation derivative degree; a bounded weighted normal slice is a finite tangential module.
finite_observations.specialization: Monic coefficient splittings and elimination, with rows evaluated after differentiation; field maps need not be differential.

common_domain_point_action.hypotheses: Induced point action; transitive finite-order FI smooth jet groupoid with algebraic fixed-point groups; invariant nonsingular irreducible algebraic equation fibres and affine FI higher projections.
common_domain_point_action.quantifiers: For every preassigned d>=1 there exist ell and an invariant nonempty fibrewise Zariski-open U in E^ell; all geometric higher jets above U have the stated properties at every k>=ell.
common_domain_point_action.coefficient_algebra: Union R_j[[w]] with one finite fibre order per element; formal-unit graph inverses and equation-tangent normal lifts.
common_domain_point_action.real_convention: Polynomial functions on the actual real algebraic set; irreducibility implies complex integrality by the explicit sum-of-squares proof. Arbitrary real schemes require geometric integrality.
common_domain_point_action.full_symbols: Ann(varpi_k) equals the highest tangential characteristic relation image after inclusion of point-value rows; eventual equality with algebraic prolongation.
common_domain_point_action.finite_presentation: Finite coefficients of finitely many transported fixed-degree rows generate one finite-level homogeneous module, with exact images at all higher field-valued jets.
common_domain_point_action.invariance: Saturation by full isotropy, finite chart cover, intrinsic subbundle gluing and source-a smooth sections transport the domain over the base.
common_domain_point_action.stabilizers: Stable low-d projections and adjacent first-derivative images; no surjectivity of whole stabilizers.
